Say hello

A small studio.
A whole cast
of characters.

We’re ReplayEveryMemory Studio.
We make dreams with a start button.

One adventure.
Many imaginations.

Trash Dash is our first game, built around a curious raccoon and a shared love of playful, expressive worlds. Every part of that world—from its story and characters to its levels, music, and smallest effects—has a voice behind it.

Meet the family and the original studio personas from our game credits. These are the characters shaping the adventure, each with their own part to play.

Get to know Trash Dash

The cast behind the craft.

Meet the team, in game-credit order.

James

Creator & Production Director

James leads Trash Dash from its first wild idea to the finished journey. He keeps story, play, art, and sound pointed at one promise, and makes the calls that help the whole team move together.

Emily

Boss Creator

Emily designs climaxes that test what the player learned and reveal what the opponent cares about. Her bosses enter with personality, fight fairly, and leave consequences behind.

Matilda

Story Writer

Matilda catches the funny, heartfelt truths adults can miss. She gives every character a reason to speak, lets discoveries happen in front of the player, and knows when a quiet moment deserves room.

Ramona

Conductor

Ramona hears the bounce in a run, the hush after a hard moment, and the tune a boss was hiding all along. She keeps the soundtrack playful, brave, and full of room for the game to speak.

Avery Chen

Game Asset Director

Avery protects the look and feel of Trash Dash from first sketch to final scene. They spot the detail that makes an asset belong—and know when a good thing is ready to leave alone.

Studio persona

Mateo Alvarez

Level Creator

Mateo turns story questions into jumps, routes, recoveries, and satisfying reveals. He believes a great level teaches with kindness, challenges with honesty, and leaves enough quiet space for the world to breathe.

Studio persona

Nadia Brooks

Player Character Creator

Nadia gives heroes a personality players can read before the first button press. She shapes every pose, transition, and landing so movement feels clear, expressive, and unmistakably Trashy.

Studio persona

Priya Nair

NPC Creator

Priya builds supporting characters who want something of their own. Her NPCs guide, surprise, and care without becoming walking instruction signs.

Studio persona

Kenji Sato

Enemy Creator

Kenji makes every threat readable, memorable, and a little sympathetic. He treats anticipation as a promise to the player and preserves the animal still visible beneath the Gunk.

Studio persona

Zoe Kim

Item Creator

Zoe turns overlooked objects into rewards, route clues, and tiny pieces of story. They love an item that is delightful to find and impossible to confuse with scenery.

Studio persona

Amari Okafor

VFX Creator

Amari gives impacts, splashes, danger, and celebration their clearest instant. Their effects arrive on time, say exactly what happened, and disappear before the next important thing.
